ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I chose Dunlin because the query is a neutral, factual listing task where raw capability matters most. Dunlin leads on IFEval (89.8 vs 86.7), which maps to the user's explicit demand for concise, no-rambling output, and on Extraction & Retrieval and MMLU-Pro, which support getting the facts right. The content has no sensitive or warmth-sensitive dimension, so neither model's preference profile is relevant — making the higher-capability model the clear pick.
